title: Baseball
text:
Baseball
Welcome to Baseball, a short exploration of Major League Baseball history through the Lahman Database. Our analysis follows the game’s long run of team and player records and highlights how the home-runs-per-game story changed across seasons.
The site also zooms in on the best career home-run leaders, showing which players set the strongest long-term marks in the sport. You can visit the Home Runs and Sluggers analysis pages from the navbar to see the full story.
